title: PackDescriptor
description: Declarative shape of a Hivemind addon pack (docs/design/addon-packs.md §8). A pack is data: an intake trigger, an optional profiling interview, the resources (skills/mcp/plugins) it wires up with ownership metadata, the loop_auth gate scopes it introduces, and the pipeline steps it injects via the core registration hook. Wave-1 scope is descriptor validation only — the reconciler that acts on this data is a separate ticket.

version.description: Pack version (semver-exact recommended, not enforced here).

core_compat.description: Compat range against the core registration hook API (addon-packs.md §5).

trigger.description: Intake condition that activates the pack. Shape is pack-defined (addon-packs.md §8); kept loose here since Wave 1 only validates the descriptor envelope.

project_md_contribution.description: PROJECT.md frontmatter keys this pack writes (the 'intent' side of the reconciler, addon-packs.md §2).

profile.description: Optional profiling interview + complexity scoring (addon-packs.md §8). Shape is pack-defined.

id.description: Resource id, unique within this descriptor. Referenced by other resources' `fallback`.

pin.description: Exact commit SHA or semver — never a range (addon-packs-plan.md §2).

required.description: hard = blocks the loop on failure; soft = degrade and report (addon-packs.md §2.3).

fallback.description: Id of another resource in this same descriptor's resources[] to fall back to when this one is soft-unavailable (addon-packs-plan.md §8). Validated as a semantic reference by the validator, not by this schema alone.

pipeline.description: Pipeline steps injected via the core registration hook (addon-packs.md §5).
